description:
Be visionary 
 
 Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research. ​ 
 
 We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.
   
 Job Description 
   
 Teledyne Micropac is looking for a candidate that will steward mission-critical products from prototype through end‑of‑life. You’ll be the go‑to engineering partner for Manufacturing, Quality, Test, Supply Chain, Sales/Applications, and Program Management, resolving issues quickly, driving yield and cost improvements, authoring/maintaining documentation, and ensuring compliance with industry standards and customer requirements. You will play a key role in ensuring these products meet demanding electrical, thermal, and reliability performance expectations across their entire lifecycle.
 
 The essential functions and key responsibilities for the position include, but are not limited to:
 
 What you'll do 
 Serve as technical owner for assigned product families.
 Own BOM integrity, part substitutions, and change control through ECOs.
 Troubleshoot and resolve production issues (process, test, materials) and partner with Manufacturing/Test Engineering to ensure stable, high‑yield processes.
 Use SPC/DoE to reduce variation and enhance yield.
 Participate in MRB and Nonconformance disposition.
 Create and maintain datasheets, product specs, work instructions, process travelers, and other manufacturing documentation.
 Support prototypes, characterization, DVT/qualification planning, and production release.
 Drive readiness of fixtures, test plans, and documentation at each phase-gate of the PLM.
 Perform hands-on testing and validation of assigned product families.
 Ensure conformance to industry, regulatory, environmental, and customer-specific requirements (e.g., AS9100 processes; MIL/JEDEC where applicable; RoHS/REACH declarations).
 Assist with internal, supplier, and customer audits as well as RCCA efforts and CAR closure.
 Lead/coordinate FA and RCCA using structured methods (5-Why, Ishikawa, FMEA)
 Support cost reductions initiatives (process/test time/materials/alternative sources) while protecting performance, quality, and reliability.
 Respond to technical inquiries from Sales team and provide application guidance and design-in support.
 Occasionally (10% or less) visit customers or suppliers as needed.
 Utilize SPICE and CAD tools for design analysis, review, and validation of changes.
 
 What you'll need 
 BS in Electrical Engineering with at least 7 years of direct experience - required
 or MS in Electrical Engineering with at least 5 years of direct experience - advantage
 Strong fundamentals in electronics and manufacturing/sustaining engineering - required
 Excellent written/verbal communication and documentation rigor - required
 Ability to prioritize across multiple products/projects with minimal oversight - required
 Proficiency with Microsoft 365; familiarity with PLM/ERP environments - required
 Broad, practical understanding of multidisciplinary engineering impacts (electrical, software, mechanical, materials) - advantage
 Tools: LTspice/PSpice (or equivalent), Cadence OrCAD/Allegro, SolidWorks - advantage
 Knowledge of aerospace/defense standards and practices (e.g., AS9100 processes; MIL‑STD‑883/202/750 methods where applicable; derating; HALT/HASS exposure) - advantageWorking knowledge of ECO processes,
 FMEA (DFMEA/PFMEA), SPC/DoE, and structured RCCA - advantage
 Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent practical application is a plus - advantage
 
 What we offer 
 Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits 
 Health, dental, and vision coverage 
 Retirement savings plan with company match 
 Paid time off and holidays 
 Opportunities for professional growth and innovation 
 A mission-driven culture focused on exploration and sustainability 
 
 What happens next 
 
 Apply online and our recruiting team will review your application. If your experience aligns, we’ll reach out to schedule an interview and discuss next steps.
   
 Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.
 
 Teledyne is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other characteristic or non-merit based factor made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws. ​
